Then HCF(15,120)=15. So overall HCF=15. Alternatively compute HCF(90,120)=30. Then HCF(15,30)=15. So same result.

Second part: find HCF(36,48)=12. Then find HCF of that result with pair (72,96). So compute HCF(12,72,96). HCF(12,72)=12. HCF(12,96)=12. So overall 12.

Thus answer: HCF(45,60)=15; HCF(15,90,120)=15. HCF(36,48)=12; HCF(12,72,96)=12.
